title: pcell-mwall with a predator catalyst kind (copies only by eating prey particles) gives no ecology: walled cells divide too rarely, so every predator outbreak just kills its host cell and the cell population declines 30 -> 4
summary: Fork of pcell-mwall-b42 (world.py): a predator particle kind arises by one-way mutation of prey daughters (mupred=2e-5), copies with probability cp Kprey (1-K) phi and kills prey with probability (cp/Ypred) Kpred (Ypred=0.5), drawing no substrate. With cp=0.4 and a leaky predator gate (gqpred=0.5, seed 0, lk_a.png, lk_a.txt) each outbreak consumes its host cell and dies with it; cells fall from 30 (t=2000) to 4 (t=40000) and predators never exceed 56 particles; with free-roaming predators (no gate) they leave cells, where they cannot copy, and never establish; at cp=0.12 they never establish (lk_c.log); at mupred=2e-4 every cell dies by t=6000 (test.txt). The b42 cells split about once per 6000 t over the whole domain, far slower than predation, so a predator-prey ecology of these cells needs a faster-dividing cell or transmission between cells; I moved the ecology to the Keller-Segel evopursuit world. One seed per setting: a direction marker, not a result.
